cohort: 1305 mother-child pairs from the MINA-Brazil population-based birth cohort study
finding: Inappropriate gestational weight gain, both above and below recommendations, was associated with adverse perinatal outcomes in Amazonian women, suggesting that INTERGROWTH-21st standards may be more suitable for this population.
mod_finding: This study on gestational weight gain in Amazonian women found an association between excessive weight gain and an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
